name: Ultramarine
description: A long six-sided shard leaning across the cell.

code.style: --rule: ( --rot: @pick(0deg, 90deg, 180deg, 270deg); @random(${shapeFrequency}) { background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(20.0% 86.0%, 36.0% 28.0%, 62.0% 10.0%, 80.0% 16.0%, 64.0% 74.0%, 38.0% 92.0%); clip-path: polygon(20.0% 86.0%, 36.0% 28.0%, 62.0% 10.0%, 80.0% 16.0%, 64.0% 74.0%, 38.0% 92.0%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); transform: rotate(@var(--rot)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
